name: Tsukimi
oneLiner: A Japanese kitchen read by moonlight — ramen, sushi, soba and rice arced as four drenched colour worlds across one night.
axisNote: The signature is an unforgettable colour world: FOUR drenched single-colour courses arced across a near-black night — crimson → amber → green → violet — each one dish glowing as a jewel out of black (the Pinterest chiaroscuro-food register). Cinematic secondary is delivered as the MOON: a code-drawn disc that crosses a fixed night sky on the scroll (the one animation system; the cinematic clock and the §9 nature-frame in one element), plus a held full-bleed quote chapter between the colours — since the s64 fix round it sits over a dim lantern-lit view of the counter and open kitchen (founder-directed). Sits deliberately between the founder's two poles: drenched single-colour (Joji) delivered with editorial Didone restraint and mono captions (Onice) — a night, not a nightclub. Distinct from every other portfolio site by being the only drenched DARK site (⑰ parchment morning, ⑱ white catalogue, First Crack warm daylight roastery).
paletteSeed: near-black night (#0a0a0f) with four drenched course worlds — crimson #4a0a10, amber #3a2205, green #0d2417, violet #1f0f30 — each with a lit accent; the moon cream + gold #c9a24b for actions and lunar touches; per-course palette is static grading (the moon is the only motion)
typeDirection: Bodoni Moda variable (Didone display — the luxe-editorial Onice serif pole) + Chivo Mono (course numbers, captions, the lunar-phase marker — the Joji mono pole) + Instrument Sans (body, readable on dark) — all OFL, vendored; CJK accents (月見 / 緋琥翠紫) ride Unicode system-CJK fallback, never a vendored CJK face
motionBudget: ONE clock — the moon crosses a fixed night sky moonrise→zenith→moonset as you scroll (transform-only on a position:fixed SVG, rAF-throttled, --p scroll progress); per-course drenched backgrounds are static CSS grading. Reduced-motion and no-JS pin the moon mid-arc and render the complete night — every course, the held quote over its counter view, the phase marker, the rabbit wink.
fixRound: 2026-07-19 (s64, founder verdict): register re-themed from fine-dining tasting menu to an everyday Japanese kitchen — ramen · sushi · soba · rice — keeping the whole structure, the moon, and the drenched colour arc (the founder's call: quality doesn't need to shout, and the moon stays because the page earns it quietly). All four course photographs re-shot low-angle (<45°) and close per the founder's food-photography direction (glistening broth, rendered fat, never top-down), and the held-quote chapter gained a dim background mint of counter seating overlooking the open kitchen. First reference-image-guided mint round: public web photographs (Wikimedia Commons + food blogs) fed to soul_2 as generation references per the founder's standing directive — references guide generation only, never enter the repo. 8 mints, 5 keepers, 3 colour-drift rejects, 0.96cr.
castingNote: The four course worlds are PEOPLE-FREE — the dish is the star (exceptional-palette showcase). Two quiet human presences at the edges: a chef working behind the counter in the held-quote background (dimmed under the scrim; the reference carried him in and the working kitchen fits the everyday register), and the warm chef-at-the-counter close (§7 craft-practitioner, face present three-quarter, looking down at the plating — the food-casting corollary honoured).
buildNote: Wink: the rabbit in the moon (tsuki no usagi) drawn faintly in the moon disc — the Tsukimi legend, for regulars. Lunar instrument: a code-drawn moon-phase marker ('tonight · waxing gibbous') ties the fictional menu to the sky. The original build's honesty gate (course I planned as tuna, minted as beet, reframed to beet) is RESOLVED in the fix round: with a real chūtoro-nigiri reference photo the crimson course is finally the tuna it was always meant to be. Reference-workflow lesson (ratcheted to the meta-prompt): soul_2's enhancer captions the reference and the caption wins over prompt text — a reference must already look like the target (the grey soba reference stayed grey through two takes; the green keeper came text-only). The amber course crops its right edge in the derive (manifest position:left) to compose out an enhancer-added decorated spoon — deterministic crop, no blur.
